# AptFinder.org

> > AptFinder.org is a comprehensive database and search tool for low-income and affordable housing in Washington State, specializing in HUD-subsidized apartments, Section 8 vouchers, and other housing assistance programs.

AptFinder.org helps housing seekers navigate affordable housing options across Washington State by providing searchable listings, eligibility information, and educational resources about federal housing programs. The site is operated by Multifamily Affordable Properties and serves as a resource for individuals and families seeking subsidized rental housing.

## Key Topics

- Low-income housing
- Affordable housing search
- HUD subsidies
- Section 8 vouchers
- Washington State housing
- Housing assistance programs
- USDA Rural Housing
- Project-based subsidies

- Housing resources

## Housing Search Tools

- [Property Listings](https://aptfinder.org/property.php): Property listings for affordable apartments with HUD subsidies and Section 8 vouchers
- [Complete Listings Database](https://aptfinder.org/listings.php): Complete affordable housing listings database for Washington State
- [Washington State Housing Search](https://aptfinder.org/washington_search.php): Washington State housing search tool for low-income and affordable apartments
- [Search by Wait List Status](https://aptfinder.org/approximate_wait_search.php): Search affordable housing by wait list status in Washington State
- [Search by Property Category](https://aptfinder.org/property_category_search.php): Filter affordable housing by category: seniors, disabled, families
- [Search by Program Type](https://aptfinder.org/program_type_search.php): Search housing by program type: HUD, USDA, Section 8, project-based
- [Alternative Search Methods](https://aptfinder.org/other_search_options.php): Alternative search methods for low-income housing across Washington

## Housing Programs & Eligibility

- [Affordability Guide](https://aptfinder.org/affordability.php): Guide to housing subsidies, Section 8 vouchers, and affordability programs
- [Understanding Housing Programs](https://aptfinder.org/help_me_understand.php): Educational guide to HUD programs, tax credits, and housing assistance
- [Income Limits Reference](https://aptfinder.org/incomelimits.php): Income limit charts for HUD, Section 8, and USDA housing programs

## Resources & Support

- [Housing Resources](https://aptfinder.org/resources.php): Links to housing resources and assistance organizations in Washington
- [User Testimonials](https://aptfinder.org/testimonials.php): User testimonials and success stories from housing seekers
- [Contact Us](https://aptfinder.org/contactus.php): Contact information for AptFinder.org and Multifamily Affordable Properties
